notes.title: Additional launch issue fixes
notes.notes: After the last start-up fix crash, we saw a handful of reports from users that still had an issue upon start-up. The team was able to make additional adjustments and we believe this update should address remaining start-up issues.

notes.title: Restored SCREENSIZE and Window Resolution options.
notes.notes: We have re-enabled a handful of SCREENSIZE and Window Resolution options that disappeared with the last update.

notes.title: Fix for remaining launch issue.
notes.notes: This update provides an additional solution to the crash at startup that some users were still experiencing after our previous update.

notes.title: Steam Cloud and Additional Startup Crashes Fixed
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue that caused Steam Cloud to not work correctly.

Additional fixes made to the crash at launch issues that will hopefully resolve it for remaining impacted players.

notes.title: Fix implemented for crash when game is launched.
notes.notes: Fixed an issue that could cause some users to crash when starting up the game or when connecting a controller.

notes.title: 90s horror adventure game Clock Tower: Rewind released outside Japan for the first time
notes.notes:
Clock Tower released originally in 1995 for the SNES and later for other systems, but it was never officially translated and supported outside of Japan until now with Clock Tower: Rewind.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2024/10/90s-horror-adventure-game-clock-tower-rewind-released-outside-japan-for-the-first-time

notes.title: One of the most influential horror games is finally coming to Steam
notes.notes:
In the horror game genre there are names that have become legends and have influenced countless other titles. Resident Evil, Silent Hill, Amnesia, and a few others. There's one, however, that has influenced more than almost any other, which is doubly impressive as it has never seen an official release outside of Japan. That's about to change, as Clock Tower: Rewind will bring the legendary first game to Steam.
